votes.motion: Continue the matter regarding 757 Chase Road until August 17th at 4:30 pm
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by fortin and second by rudd, this matter was continued until august 17th at 4:30 pm. all in favor.

votes.motion: Allow the existing well at 48 Island Road to be used for irrigation purposes with the receipt of a document showing the house has been completely disconnected from the potable water system
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by rudd, the board voted to allow the existing well to be used for irrigation purposes with the receipt of a document showing the house has been completely discounted from the house. all in favor.

decisions.decision: 757 Chase Road: Matter continued pending receipt of documentation that the existing well has been disconnected from potable water systems and buildings, a site plan showing the proposed car washing area, and plans for the proposed industrial wastewater holding tank, conditioned on the installation of the holding tank prior to any car washing on site
decisions.quote: the following documents are required: documentation that the existing well has been disconnected from the potable water systems and buildings; a site plan showing the proposed car washing area; plans for the proposed industrial wastewater holding tank; and conditioned on the installation of the holding tank prior to any car washing on site

decisions.decision: Old Primary School: Food Pantry should provide the Board of Health with a site plan if they decide to move forward, and will need a food service permit through Nashoba Associated Boards of Health
decisions.quote: if the food bank does decide to move forward, they would need to provide the board of health with a site plan of their proposal. in addition, they would need a food service permit through nashoba associated boards of health.
